billingOversight.title: Billing & revenue oversight
billingOversight.subtitle: Confirm bank-transfer payments, track subscriptions, and monitor revenue.
billingOversight.permissionBody: You don't have permission to access billing oversight.
billingOversight.conflictBody: The record was updated elsewhere. The list has been reloaded.
billingOversight.planEmptyBody: Create a plan to start selling tiers to this audience.
billingOversight.planCatalogSubtitle: Create and tune plans, prices, visibility, and quotas without changing code.
billingOversight.planFormBody: Configure the price and limits applied when a user selects or activates this plan.
billingOversight.planEmpty: There are no plans in this catalogue.
billingOversight.planLimitsHint: Use supported keys such as cv_active_quota, job_post_quota, ai_daily_cost_quota_usd.
billingOversight.emptyBody: No subscriptions match the current filter.
billingOversight.noActions: No actions are available for this status.
billingOversight.markPaidBody: Record the bank transfer for {plan} and activate it.
billingOversight.markPaidNote: Enter the bank-transfer reference. The plan will move to active.
billingOversight.paymentRefHint: The transaction or reference code from the bank statement.
billingOversight.cancelBody: Cancel {plan}. The principal reverts to default limits.
billingOversight.cancelNote: This cancels the plan immediately and reverts to default limits.
billingOversight.cancelReasonHint: Internal reason; not sent to the user.
